items.information: Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODcyMzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--4a8a4b53cfb95f294928156d906acac64755d4b3/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 2x2 και Πυραμίδα ή 4x4 και 5x5 επιθυμείτε. Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα καλωσορίζοντας το καλοκαίρι για ακόμα μία φορά στο αγαπημένο μας πλέον Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **ATHENS SUMMER BREAK A 2025.** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 2x2 and Pyraminx or 4x4 and 5x5 you prefer. Join un on the first summer competition of the year and have a good time once again at the familiar Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **ATHENS SUMMER BREAK A 2025.** Competition Α events: * 3x3 * 2x2 * Pyraminx Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## Sponsorship ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY5MTksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--043850cb450564025444969edb4c94d522019cb1/image.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** will have discounted rates for accommodation for those wanting to overnight at the hotel during the weekend of the competition. Be sure to keep a lookout for more information in this regard. Their restaurant will also be open for meals and refreshments during the competition. Please see the Legacy Centurion Hotel tab for more information. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 20 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! - Inscrições no dia do campeonato estarão abertas somente para 3x3x3. **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition 20 minutes before the modality that you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubers. - Try to have a lot of fun! - Entries on the day of the competition will only be open for 3x3x3.

items.information: ## Welcome to Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025! ### This competition is open to everyone to compete in, regardless of nationality or experience level. [![Kewbz](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1Y0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3fb56d1f073b7544d2cf011acfe92e29f237f69/Kewbz_Logo.png)](https://ukspeedcubes.co.uk/) ![Scottish Championship Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQyNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c4ab4fd8fb34605abb30bab45291a8318375f865/Scottish%20Champs%20Logo.png) #### New Competitors: If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52598-faq) and the [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52599-important-information) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. #### Free T-Shirt: By registering and attending Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025, you'll receive a free Kewbz Scottish Championship 2025 T-shirt! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size. A sizing guide is provided in the** [T-Shirt tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#52603-t-shirt-sizes). #### Qualifications: **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Skewb, Pyraminx, and 3x3 One-Handed do not have any qualification requirements and remain open to everyone, including new competitors, to compete in**. Other events have qualification requirements in place. If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025/#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by May 19th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. #### Spectators and Guests: Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There is no need to pre-book. #### Prizes: As this is the Kewbz Scottish Championship, **only competitors who are Scottish** (please see the [prizes eligiblity tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzScottishChampionship2025#53036-prizes-eligibility) for further details) **will be eligible for prizes**. The competition remains open for competitors of all nationalities and UK regions to compete. #### Podium Positions: If fewer than three Scottish competitors proceed to the final of an event, any remaining podium positions will be determined using the results of the highest ranked Scottish competitors in the previous round. #### Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025: The Kewbz Scottish Championship Blind Off 2025 will be held separately on Saturday 24th May in Glasgow. This competition will host 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3 Fewest Moves. Podiummers at the Blind Off will be crowned at Kewbz Scottish Championship. #### Invitation Letters: Should you need a Visa invitation letter, or a note from us to help authorise time off school, please [get in touch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition). #### Media Enquiries: Please [contact us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=KewbzScottishChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition) for all media enquiries.

items.name: Saint-Augustin A 2025
items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Saint-Augustin 2025 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours, pour offrir une variété maximale d'épreuves! Vous pouvez choisir entre [Saint-Augustin 2025 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (samedi) et [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (dimanche). Ces compétitions ont des événements différents. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Saint-Augustin 2025 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series, to offer the most event variety we can! You can choose between [Saint-Augustin 2024 A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinA2025/) (Saturday) or [Saint-Augustin 2025 B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SaintAugustinB2025/) (Sunday). These competitions are have different event sets. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png) **Western Development Museum: The registration fee for this competition includes admission to the Western Development Museum for the competitors and their guests.** There will be a longer lunch break in the competition schedule so everyone can enjoy the museum. Learn more about the WDM at their website [here](https://wdm.ca/north-battleford/). We ask attendees to limit themselves to two guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 240 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. **First Time Competitors:** All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. **Megaminx and Square-1:** There will be no cutoff for Megaminx or Square-1 at this competition. The cumulative time limit for megaminx is 30 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. Megaminx is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results. **Draw prizes:** There will be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. **Notice of Filming and Photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 17 y domingo 18 de mayo de 2025. El Mololoa Open 2025 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2025, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 17, and Sunday, May 18, 2025. Mololoa Open 2025 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B.:** On Friday, only one attempt of 3x3 Multi-BLD will be held. If you do not want to compete in that event, you do not have to come already on Friday, it is enough that you arrive first before your first event starts on Saturday. items.name: Spring Bozeman 2025
items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Bozeman for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 3-26-2025) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information: **Қазақша** QBERS League In Astana 2025 – Астанадағы ашық жарыс. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 5000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. **Русский** QBERS League In Astana 2025 - это открытые соревнования в Астане. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 5000. Главная событие сорвенований - QBERS League. QBERS League - это неоффицальный ивент, который будет проводиться в формате турнирной сетки. Подробнее про QBERS League смотрите во вкладках. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. **English** QBERS League In Astana 2025 is an open competition in Astana. The base registration fee for any number of events is 5000 tenge. The main event of the competition is QBERS League. QBERS League is an unofficial event that will be held in the format of a tournament grid. For more information about QBERS League, see the tabs. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.name: Peristeri Spring Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxNDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3bff12c8b9b6016985d4932977574e412605ceb3/486747483_24056017737321961_6930283358538797018_n.jpg) Το Peristeri Spring Open 2025 θα είναι o τρίτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στον Δήμο Περιστερίου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Peristeri Spring Open 2025 will be Greece’s third official competition of 2025 and the first ever to be held in the Municipality of Peristeri! For two days, in the conference hall of KYVE Peristeriou, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: # Première Compétition Officielle de Speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! Un moment historique! Rejoignez-nous le **samedi 19 avril** pour la toute première compétition officielle WCA en **Côte d’Ivoire**! Que vous soyez un compétiteur expérimenté ou un nouveau venu dans le monde du speedcubing, c’est l’occasion parfaite de participer à cet événement unique. Quatre épreuves officielles sont au programme : **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx** et **3x3 à une main**. Vous pouvez choisir de participer à l'une ou à toutes! **Première compétition WCA?** Pas de souci! Un **tutoriel pour les débutants** vous expliquera tout ce qu’il faut savoir sur la compétition et l’arbitrage. N’oubliez pas d’apporter une **pièce d’identité** pour l’inscription. Ne manquez pas cette occasion historique - venez résoudre, concourir et faire partie de la communauté grandissante du speedcubing en Côte d’Ivoire! # Ivory Coast’s First-Ever Official WCA Competition! History is being made! Join us on **Saturday, April 19th**, for the first-ever WCA speedcubing competition in **Ivory Coast**! Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to cubing, this is your chance to be part of something special. We'll be holding four official events, including **3x3**, **2x2**, **Pyraminx**, and **One-Handed** - compete in any or all of them! **New to WCA competitions?** No worries! We’ll have a **newcomer tutorial** to guide you through competing and judging. Just bring a form of ID for registration, and get ready to experience the thrill of official speedcubing. Don’t miss this historic event - come solve, compete, and be part of Ivory Coast’s growing cubing community!

items.information: #Please check the schedule to find possible time slots. Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in. #Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1. Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3. - On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot. - Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments. We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed. Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis. If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot. - If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) #This is an expo first! We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing! - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo. items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** ** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** ** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: 🇧🇷 O Colatina Open 2025 é 2º Campeonato Oficial de Colatina. Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ColatinaOpen2025/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em participará; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Colatina Open 2025 is the 2st Official Colatina Competition. We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ColatinaOpen2025/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ4ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--70dda75542644ea0af198d4bbc96659f421ae2ba/Maza%20(1).png) ###### Español: ¡Bienvenidos al “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025”, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Sinaloa! ¡Con el majestuoso océano pacífico a tus espaldas, el “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025” promete ser el torneo con la vista más espectacular desde tu estación de competidor! Reunirá a cuberos de todo el noroeste del Pacífico mexicano y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia está organizada por el Sinaloa SpeedCube Team y el Team Nayarit. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### Inglés: Welcome to “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025,” the first official competition in the beautiful state of Sinaloa! With the majestic Pacific Ocean at your back, “Mano Salada Mazatlán 2025” promises to be the tournament with the most spectacular view from your competitor station! It will bring together cubers from all over the northwestern Pacific region of Mexico and beyond, giving them the chance to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers an opportunity for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by the Sinaloa SpeedCube Team and Team Nayarit. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association (WCA) event. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the WCA regulations prior to the competition.

items.name: Chiclayo Classic 2025
items.information: Bienvenidos al segundo torneo oficial del año en Chiclayo. Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChiclayoClassic2025/register) para obtener información detallada. Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo. [Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY) ​ Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. **ENGLISH** Welcome to the second official competition of the year in Chiclayo. See the [Register tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChiclayoClassic2025/register) for detailed information. Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted. [WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information: ### WCA Newcomer Month ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [FR] Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024. Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants : 50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi. Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens. Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous. [EN] This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: Пожалуйста, смотрите наш Инстаграм аккаунт(https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ​ ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjQ3NzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b83885f0ca3e638334b1142605be9fcc75373ce5/newcm.png) (SRB) **Irig Newcommer Day 2025** je dvadeset i četvrto po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. Ovo takmičenje učestvuje u zvaničnom **WCA Mesecu Novih Takmičara 2025**. Proces registracije obezbeđuje 50% mesta za nove takmičare. Novi takmičari su oni koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2025. godine. Takmičari koji imaju WCA ID iz 2024. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi takmičari i dalje moraju ispuniti sve zahteve za prijavu kako bi njihova prijava bila smatrana potpunom. **Prijave će se prihvatati na sledeći način:** * 50% mesta, određenih ograničenjem broja takmičara, obezbeđeno je za nove takmičare. * Ako se više od 50% novih takmičara prijavi pre nego što se preostalih 50% mesta popuni povratnicima, dalja prijava će se prihvatati uobičajenim redosledom za nove takmičare i povratnike istovremeno. * Ako mesta obezbeđena za nove takmičare ne popune novi takmičari dve nedelje pre zatvaranja registracija, preostala mesta, do ograničenja broja takmičara, biće dodeljena prijavljenim povratnicima. ------------------------ (ENG) **Irig Newcommer Day 2025** is the 24th speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. This competition is participating in the official **WCA Newcomer Month 2025**. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM3NTUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5c88ea3767d89107228e535dd6fe66cfbe9b5754/Kopie%20Start%20in%20Veenendaal%20(1).png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTE0MDAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--bec7cd53245e9b32a1ec492066d9fd90a47d5691/scnl_logo.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM2MjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--5adc2f3526b66991cbfe87c0840d09451c6723c6/NCM%202025%20A1.png) # Engels This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 25% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 75% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 25% of new competitors register before 75% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. See the "Newcomers" tab. # Nederlands Deze wedstrijd doet mee met de officiële WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Tijdens de inschrijving wordt 25% van de competitor limit gereserveerd voor nieuwkomers. Nieuwkomers zijn iedereen zonder WCA ID en WCA ID met 2025. Terugkerende deelnemers zijn iedereen met een 2024 WCA ID en eerder. Alle deelnemers moeten daarnaast ook voldoen aan alle andere inschrijfeisen om de inschrijving te laten tellen. Inschrijvingen worden als volgt geaccepteerd: 25% van de competitor limit is gereserveerd voor nieuwkomers. De andere 75% voor terugkerende deelnemers gaat op volgorde van WCA inschrijving. Als meer dan 25% nieuwkomers inschrijven, voordat de overige 75% vol zit gaan zowel de nieuwkomers als de terugkerende deelnemers op volgorde van WCA inschrijving samen met de terugkomende deelnemers. Als de 25% van de competitor limit die gereserveerd is voor nieuwkomers niet vol raakt twee weken voordat de inschrijving dicht gaat, dan komen deze plekken beschikbaar voor zowel nieuwkomers als terugkerende deelnemers. Zie tabblad "Nieuwkomersactie"

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdUplIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92701aef7af516be4361993a7c4150fa9e22ea2d/image.png) # This competition features easy and popular events, making it perfect for newcomers. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA3NzIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--1ce2d0d5715009d578d2d8e7e5719e7d7b032738/newcomers2025.png) **First Time Competitors:** All newcomers must be familiar with the WCA Regulations before competing. There is a video [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY&ab_channel=SpeedcubingCanada) for a basic rundown of a competition. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Judging:** All competitors are expected to help at this competition. We will have a judging tutorial at the beginning of the day. All competitors will be assigned to judge 1 group of each of the events they are competing in. There will also be draw prizes throughout the day to encourage competitors to stay after their round is done. **Mystery event:** There will be a mystery event at lunch. You only need to know how to solve a 3x3 to participate. **4x4** There will be no cutoff for 4x4 at this competition. The cumulative time limit is 20 minutes. You may take over 10 minutes to do a single solve if you let your judge know beforehand. 4x4 is scheduled such that overflow into lunch is acceptable so everyone can get results. --- We ask attendees to limit themselves to one guest per competitor if possible so that we do not go over capacity limits for this venue which is 160 people. Attendance is not required for the entire competition, however please arrive at least 15 minutes before your event's planned start time. Please bring your own cubes for the events you are competing in. Notice of Filming and Photography: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [IT] Si tratta di una gara adatta ai principianti! Tutti sono i benvenuti, ma se non avete mai gareggiato prima d'ora, questa è la gara a cui iscriversi! Questa gara fa parte del WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Il processo di iscrizione riserverà il 50% dei posti ai nuovi concorrenti. Per nuovi concorrenti si intende che non hanno un ID WCA o un ID WCA del 2025. I concorrenti che ritornano sono considerati in possesso di un ID WCA del 2024 o precedente. Tutti i concorrenti devono comunque rispettare tutti i requisiti di registrazione affinché la loro iscrizione sia considerata completa. Le iscrizioni saranno accettate in base a quanto segue: Il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è riservato ai nuovi concorrenti. Inizialmente, il 50% dei posti, come definito dal limite dei concorrenti, è disponibile per i concorrenti che ritornano, in base all'ordine di arrivo. Se più del 50% dei nuovi concorrenti si iscrive prima che il 50% dei posti sia occupato dai concorrenti che ritornano, ogni ulteriore nuovo concorrente sarà accettato in base all'ordine di arrivo, insieme ai concorrenti che ritornano. Se i posti riservati ai nuovi concorrenti non vengono occupati da nuovi concorrenti prima della chiusura delle iscrizioni due settimane prima della gara, i posti rimanenti, fino al limite dei concorrenti, saranno accettati dai concorrenti già iscritti. Questa gara è una competizione in serie con **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. È possibile iscriversi e partecipare a una sola di queste gare. [EN] This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. This competition is a series competition with **Show Your Skills in Ponte Tresa 2025**. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2025 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan und Florian Truckenthanner. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan and Florian Truckenthanner. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: **Durban’s First 2-Day Cubing Competition in Over Two Years!** Join us for an action-packed weekend of speedcubing on March 21st & 22nd! Day 1 (Friday) falls on Human Rights Day, making it the perfect opportunity to challenge yourself with events you don't always see - like Clock, Megaminx, and even 3x3 Blindfolded! If you're looking to try something new, this is your chance. Day 2 (Saturday) is all about the fan favorites: Pyraminx, 2x2, and a full three rounds of 3x3. Whether you're a seasoned competitor or brand new to WCA events, there's something for you. New to competing? No problem! We'll have a newcomer tutorial to walk you through competing and judging (yes, even first-timers help with judging). Just remember to bring a form of ID for registration. While most beginner-friendly events happen on Saturday, you're absolutely welcome to compete on Friday too! Don't miss out - come test your skills, meet fellow cubers, and be part of Durban's cubing community!

O processo de inscrição reservará 50% das vagas para novatos. Novatos são considerados como não tendo ID da WCA ou um ID da WCA com 2025. Os competidores veteranos são considerados como tendo um ID da WCA de 2024 ou anterior. Todos os competidores ainda devem seguir todos os requisitos de inscrição para que sua inscrição seja considerada completa. As inscrições serão aceitas com base nos seguintes critérios: * 50% das vagas (30 vagas) são inicialmente reservadas para competidores novatos. * 50% das vagas (30 vagas) estarão disponíveis para competidores veteranos, por ordem de chegada. * Se mais de 30 competidores novatos se inscreverem antes que 60 vagas sejam preenchidas por competidores veteranos, quaisquer novatos adicionais serão aceitos por ordem de chegada, juntamente com os competidores veteranos. * Se as 30 vagas reservadas para novatos não forem preenchidas por novatos duas semanas antes da competição (até dia 2 de Março de 2025), as vagas restantes, até o limite de competidores, serão aceitas de competidores veteranos. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com o delegado ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% da taxa de inscrição será reembolsada se o competidor desistir até 9 de março de 2025. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. # English This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. Ako trebate dodatne informacije ili želite promijeniti svoju registraciju, molimo vas da pošaljete e-mail preko [WCA kontakt formulara](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=LipovljaniNewcomerDay2025&contactRecipient=competition) Ovo natjecanje sudjeluje u službenom WCA Mjesecu Novih Natjecatelja 2025. **Proces registracije osigurava 50% mjesta za nove natjecatelje.** Novi natjecatelji su oni natjecatelji koji još nemaju WCA ID ili imaju WCA ID iz 2025. godine. Natjecatelji koji imaju WCA ID od 2024. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Svi natjecatelji i dalje moraju slijediti sve zahtjeve za prijavu kako bi se njihova prijava smatrala potpunom. #### Prijave će se prihvačati na sljedeći način: * 50% mjesta određenih limitom broja natjecatelja, osigurano je za nove natjecatelje. * Na početku je za povratnike na raspolaganju 50% mjesta, određenih limitom broja natjecatelja. Prijave će se primati uobičajenim redoslijedom po principu "tko prvi, njegovo". * Ako se više od 50% novih natjecatelja prijavi prije nego što se preostalih 50% mjesta popuni povratnicima, daljnje prijave se prihvaćaju uobičajenim redoslijedom za nove natjecatelje i povratnike u isto vrijeme. * Ako mjesta osigurana za nove natjecatelje ne popune novi natjecatelji dva tjedna prije zatvaranja registracija, preostala mjesta, do ograničenja natjecatelja, bit će prihvaćena od registriranih povratnika. Za više informacija, molimo provjerite kartice! - - - ##### [EN] This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Croatia. If you need any additional information, or if you would like to change your registration, please write an e-mail over the [WCA contact form](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=LipovljaniNewcomerDay2025&contactRecipient=competition) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. **The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors.** New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. ##### Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. For more information, please check the tabs!

items.name: Rahn Education Open 2025
items.information: **Deutsch** Herzlich Willkommen zur **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig Nach den ersten beiden Competitions 2023 und 2024 sowie den Rubik's German Nationals 2024 können wir **Leipzig** nun zu einem etablierten Cubing-Standort zählen. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet wieder eine schöne Venue in perfekter zentraler Lage in Leipzig, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. Diese Ausgabe der **Rahn Education Open** im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month richtet sich an neue und unerfahrene Cuber. Bei der Anmeldung werden deshalb 43,75% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmende ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** Welcome to the **Rahn Education Open 2025** in Leipzig After the first two competitions in 2023 and 2024 and the Rubik's German Nationals 2024, we can now count **Leipzig** as an established cubing location. We, the organizing team, are looking forward to your numerous appearances. Once again, you can expect a beautiful venue in a perfect central location in Leipzig, a motivated organizing team and much more. This edition of the **Rahn Education Open** as part of the official WCA Newcomer Month is aimed at new and inexperienced cubers. When registering, 43.75% of the places will therefore be reserved for new participants. Participants without a WCA ID or with a WCA ID from the year 2025 are considered new participants. Returning participants have a WCA ID from the year 2024 or earlier. All participants must continue to fulfill all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. You can find more information on how registrations are accepted in the “Newcomer Month” tab. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

A inscrição deve ser feita exclusivamente pelo site, com o pagamento antecipado da taxa via Stripe, diretamente na plataforma da WCA. A confirmação da inscrição no site da WCA ocorrerá somente após a validação do pagamento. Para mais detalhes, acesse a aba Inscrever. On the day of the championship, registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 category. Registration must be completed exclusively through the website, with the registration fee paid in advance via Stripe, directly on the WCA platform. Registration on the WCA website will only be confirmed after payment validation. For more details, visit the Register tab. If you have any difficulties registering, watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU) for instructions. Before the competition, please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) carefully. items.information: ## Welcome to the Malaysia Newcomer 2025! [![Newcomer logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjA4NzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--17cadd2ced923d2d26251d09fce733b54618627e/%EC%8A%A4%ED%81%AC%EB%A6%B0%EC%83%B7%202024-12-25%2000.10.29.png)](https://linktr.ee/newcomermonth) [![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/MalaysiaNewComer2025) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: - 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. - If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. - If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Kindly read through all tabs on this page as they contain very useful information.** All competitors are advised to review the information provided in the ["**Updates & Announcements**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaNewComer2025#54278-updates-announcements). New competitors, in particular, should carefully read the ["**New Competitors**"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MalaysiaNewComer2025#54279-new-competitors) for essential details before registering. Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information. ***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***

items.name: Let's Solve Liberec 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYzNTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3108208eb7baaec4005983963bd4455293cbb240/1000049076.png) ### ČEŠTINA Tato soutěž se účastní oficiálního Měsíce nováčků WCA 2025. Při registraci bude 50 % míst vyhrazeno pro nováčky. Za nováčky se považují ti, kteří ještě na své první WCA soutěži nebyli, nebo na ní byli v roce 2025 (nemají WCA ID, nebo mají WCA ID s rokem 2025). Za vracející se soutěžící se považujeme ty, kteří mají WCA ID s rokem 2024 a méně. Všichni soutěžící musí i nadále dodržet všechny registrační požadavky, aby jejich registrace byla považována za kompletní. Registrace budou přijímány na základě následujících kritérií: * 50 % míst je vyhrazeno pro nové soutěžící. * Na zbylých 50 % míst budou přijati vracející se soutěžící podle pořadí přihlášení. * Po obsazení vyhrazené kapacity pro nováčky budou na zbývající místa přijímáni jak vracející se soutěžící, tak nováčci, podle pořadí přihlášení. * Nebude-li vyhrazená kapacita pro nováčky naplněna 2 týdny před začátkem soutěže, budou na tato místa přijímáni i vracející se soutěžící, dle pořadí registrace. #### **Pódium pro nováčky** S potěšením oznamujeme, že v kategorii 3x3x3 budeme vyhlašovat pódium pro nové soutěžící. ### ENGLISH This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50 % of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50 % of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 50 % of new competitors register before 50 % of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. #### **Newcomer podium** We are excited to announce that special podium awards will be presented to newcomers in the 3x3x3 event.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7f38aa440f2f5ea4ba0f22de16d4f6cdf4c47946/IMG-20250124-WA0034.jpg) ​ ##### Español ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Bienvenidos a **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla se prepara para recibirte en un torneo que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades y conocimientos. **¿Qué tan lejos puede llegar tu mente?** El nombre del torneo y nuestra categoría principal no son coincidencia. Cada detalle ha sido pensado para resaltar la conexión entre la fuerza mental y el desafío que representa este evento. El Megaminx, con su forma dodecaédrica, representa un verdadero desafío para la mente, exigiendo combinar estrategia, eficiencia, precisión, visión espacial y velocidad. Así es como Megaminx se convierte en el corazón de este torneo, acompañado de otras categorías desafiantes que pondrán a prueba tu mente. Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2025 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to **Mega-Mente Puebla 2025**! Puebla is ready to welcome you to a tournament that will challenge your knowledge and skills. **How far can your mind go?** The name of the tournament and our main category are no coincidence. Every detail has been carefully designed to highlight the connection between mental strength and the challenge this event represents. The Megaminx, with its dodecahedral shape, embodies a true mental challenge, demanding a combination of strategy, efficiency, precision, spatial awareness, and speed. This is why the Megaminx becomes the heart of this tournament, accompanied by other challenging categories that will put your mind to the test. This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Mega-Mind Puebla 2025 is an official WCA competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.name: Romandie Rookies 2025
items.information: ### WCA Newcomer Month ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg) [FR] C'est une compétition très accessible pour les débutants ! Tout le monde est le bienvenu mais si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition auparavant, c'est celle à laquelle vous devez vous inscrire ! Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024. Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants : 50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi. Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens. Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous. Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Romandie Doigts Rapides 2025. Vous ne pouvez vous inscrire et participer qu'à l'une de ces compétitions. [EN] This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for! This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. This competition is a series competition with Romandie Doigtes Rapides 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2025
items.information: **English** **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

We are thrilled to announce the first official Rubik’s cube tournament in the northernmost city of Chile. This unique event offers the chance to compete in 3 official categories, testing your speed, skill, and focus. Whether you’re a beginner or a seasoned competitor, this championship is your time to shine in an atmosphere full of excitement and community. Don’t miss this historic day in the City of Eternal Spring!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTQ1NTAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c770014c6db789e76c32778326e0f6980f437a47/466472712_1925266651296844_7482586112726949324_n.jpg) Το Trikala Open 2025 θα είναι o πρωτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 στην πανέμορφη και υπερσύγχρονη πόλη των Τρικάλων! Στο αμφιθεατρικά χτισμένο ξενοδοχείο Ananti Resort & Spa, σε αίθουσα με πανοραμική θέα στην πόλη, θα διαγωνιστούν για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Trikala Open 2025 will be the first official competition in Greece for 2025, held in the beautiful and ultra-modern city of Trikala! At the amphitheatrically built Ananti Resort & Spa, in a hall with panoramic views of the city, Cubers of all ages and skill levels, both newcomers and veterans, from across the country and beyond, will compete for two days.
