items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNjAsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--664f7af1cb593a99c2c06ca90444fbfb49eff7db/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg)[](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTYyNTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--61d1447a942fc176de0673dc670e37b5a873f2ec/LOGO%20CAMPEONATO.jpg) # Português A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando o bom andamento da competição, **ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador** nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram previstos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos, você compete; no outro, deverá ajudar a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores **menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável**. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. **COMPETIDORES NOVATOS** devem asssitir [a este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) para aprender como competir em uma competição oficial de Cubo Mágico. **Não haverá tutorial para competidores novatos no dia da competição** As inscrições custam R$ 35,00 (trinta e cinco reais) e se encerram no dia 22 de janeiro de 2025 às 23h59min (horário local). A sua inscrição só será aceita após o cumprimento de todas as etapas de inscrição (pagamento e envio do comprovante por e-mail, com todas as informações solicitadas). O pagamento da inscrição não dá direito a acompanhantes. Convidados e espectadores, inclusive os responsáveis por menores de 16 anos, devem pagar uma taxa de R$ 10,00 (dez reais) para poderem ingressar no evento, preferencialmente antecipadamente. O espaço comporta apenas 35 acompanhantes no total, de modo que reservamos 1 acompanhante por competidor. Caso você queira levar mais de 1 acompanhante, sugerimos garantir vaga do 1o acompanhante e colocar os demais na lista de espera. Ao término das inscrições, entraremos em contato informando caso sobrem vagas de acompanhantes, para que você exerça a opção de levar mais. Inscrições no local serão aceitas no valor de R$ 45,00 (quarenta e cinco reais), caso haja vagas. Acompanhantes e espectadores poderão comprar seu ingresso no dia pelo valor de R$ 20,00 (vinte reais), caso haja vagas. **Modalidade não-oficial:** Este campeonato contará com uma modalidade extra e inovadora: Skewb OH (com uma mão) # English Registration is open to any person, from any country. To ensure the smooth running of the competition, **by registering for an event, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler** in that event (as provided by the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming overwhelming for just a few. Each event will have at least two groups for each event. In one of the groups, you compete; in the other you should help to scramble or as a judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors **under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian**. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children. **FIRST TIME COMPETITORS** must watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU&pp=ygUPYWJyYWNtIHR1dG9yaWFs) In order to learn how to compete in an official Rubik's Cube competition. **No tutorial for newcomers will occur at the competition** Registration costs R$35.00 (thirty five Brazilian reais) and close on January 22, 2025 at 23:59 (local time). Your registration will only be accepted once all the registration steps have been completed (payment and sending of proof) by e-mail, with all the information required). Payment of registration fee does not guarantee the competitor a companion. Guests and spectators, including the guardians of people under 16, must pay a fee of R$10.00 to enter the event, preferably in advance. The space can only hold 35 companions in total, so we reserve 1 companion per competitor. If you would like to bring more than 1 companion, we suggest that you secure a place for the 1st companion and put the others on the waiting list. At the end of registration, we'll contact you to let you know if there are any places left, so that you can choose to bring more. On-site registrations will be accepted for R$45.00 (fourty five Brazilian reais), if there are still places. Guests and spectators can buy their tickets on the day for R$20.00 (twenty Brazilian reais), if there are still places. **Unofficial Event:** This competition will count with an extra and innovative event: Skewb OH (one-handed)

items.information: (SRB) Battle For Belgrade 2025 je dvadeset i treće po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Ovo takmičenje će se razlikovati od uobičajenih takmičenja koja smo do sada organizovali. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--332177ea99a8c8d5f8b82db10b1ac1f7c00234a9/io%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed. This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Ottawa Mini Winter A 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Mini Winter Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa Mini Winter B 2025 (Saturday Morning) and Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {email d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'hiver d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa Mini Winter B 2025 (samedi matin) et Ottawa Mini Winter C 2025 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYzOTcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--40d6a92906ae7958b380fe38d926638d59b4dabd/MIRA%20LABS%20LOGO%20COLORED.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4ODcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--b16871971da44f65ec3100f26afb9b425073d72e/CITYMALL%20MINI%20BANNER.png) Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**! This event welcomes participants of all ages and skill levels, with generous cut-off times to encourage broader participation. The 3x3x3 cube, our main event, will feature three thrilling rounds, while the 2x2x2 cube will have two rounds. To revive the community’s interest in specialized categories, we’re also offering two rounds for Clock and Square-1, while the remaining events will each feature a single, intense round. By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Taxas de inscrição não serão devolvidas em nenhuma circunstância. - Não serão aceitas inscrições no local. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Registration fees will not be refunded under any circumstances. - On-site registrations will not be accepted. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: ### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only. Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti. Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.** Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag. Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.* --- ### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb. The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join. Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions. There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event. For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.** Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag. Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.*

items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 O **Pé Vermelho II** é a segunda edição do nosso campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **07/12/2024**, ou até que o **limite de 70 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Fique atento aos horários de credenciamento na aba [Cronograma](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule). Chegue com antecedência para fazer seu credenciamento antes de qualquer modalidade que você for participar. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho II** is the second edition of our **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register) tab. * Registration closes on **12/07/2024**, or whenever the **limit of 70 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Pay attention to check-in times in the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule) tab. Please arrive early in order to check-in before participating in any event. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun! --- [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc1OTEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--930733faec45c31f0dd172905b90a8eceaa7b5f4/CUBOmenor.png)] (https://www.instagram.com/pevermelhocubo/) ### Realização: **Grupo Escoteiro Verde Vale - 3/PR** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdTlJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--16e16932678a6610581fca6a2b80723d8549fe13/gevv.png)](https://www.instagram.com/geverdevale/) ### Apoio: **Associação Guarda Mirim de Londrina** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBak5JIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--570d92311785515d92cf46545f84e0c0ed16a933/image.png)](https://www.guardamirimlondrina.org.br/)

items.name: Cape Cubes Challenge 2024
items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2024 - Cape Cubes Challenge! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. Please keep in mind that we **will not** be accepting on-the-day registration. We are going to be using printed nametags and the Competition Groups website for competitor roles and duties and to do this we will need to close the registration period before the competition begins. A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop at the competition. ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp) **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

items.name: Centennial State Cube Off 2024
items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Erie for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (11:00 PM UTC 12-06-2024) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.name: Open Christmas Cube Huancayo 2024
items.information: ### **IMPORTANTE** Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo. * Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#50386-registro-registration) para conocer el método de registro. * Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo. * Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024/register) * Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo. [Cómo competir en un torneo WCA - Reglas básicas - ASA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFCBh3i7TiY) [Tutorial para competidores nuevos - Jael Riggenbach](https://www.facebook.com/100000565031843/videos/3156907307906324/) • * Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. ### **IMPORTANT** You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament. * Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#50386-registro-registration) to know the registration method. * Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram. * To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024/register) * We also recommend that you review this video to have a clearer notion of how the competition will be conducted. [WCA Competitor Tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) • * It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: CuBeaulieu Craze 2024
items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who will be the sponsor for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Please be aware that we will likely run ahead of schedule throughout the weekend. Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. #### About CubingZA ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png) CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Desde o ano passados, estamos trabalhando com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! Starting last year, we are working with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzcxMTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--65176dceb5a653113b9a7ce41294d2d1043cdf37/yollotl.png) **ESPAÑOL** El amor por los cubos va más allá de solo resolver un rompecabezas; es una pasión que desafía la mente, agudiza la concentración y une a personas con el mismo entusiasmo. En la competencia Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024, te invitamos a ser parte de esta experiencia única, donde no solo pondrás a prueba tu habilidad y velocidad, sino que también compartirás momentos inolvidables con una comunidad vibrante de cuberos. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **English** The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Y3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--da1436f51b6bdf99f61924b5ef7f58cd5d26107f/Coralito%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, la tercera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Nayarit y primera en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de La Cruz de Huanacaxtle los días 9 y 10 de noviembre de 2024. El Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es organizada por el Team Nayarit y la comunidad Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, the third official competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit and the first one in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of La Cruz de Huanacaxtle on November 9th and 10th, 2024. The Coralito Bahía De Banderas will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by Team Nayarit and the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Beginner and Blind Cape Town 2024
items.information: Welcome to Beginner and Blind Cape Town 2024! This competition focuses on blindfolded events on the Saturday and the more popular events on the Sunday. We've made the focus, particularly for Day 2, to get as many people as possible through to the second rounds so you'll get more opportunities to compete throughout the day. And then stick around for some fun in a 3x3 head to head finals to finish off the day. All competitors are expected to help out with volunteering - judging, running, and scrambling - please see the Competitor Information and FAQ tabs. A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop at the competition. ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp)

items.name: Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Norrland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Norrlandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2024#43369-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Norrland can win titles and prizes at the Norrland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2024#43369-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
